title: RADIATOR GRILLE LOWER PANEL EXTENSION
summary: Extension [1] (radiator grille lower panel extension, the reinforcement strip under the lower front valance) is attached under the radiator grille lower panel with screw assemblies [3] and nut assemblies [2] (75-95 lb-in). The front bumper guard and the C/MBR (crossmember) extension brackets bolt to it; those are in UPC 14.

fastening.note: Screw assemblies [3] pass through the lower panel and extension [1]; nut assemblies [2] (torque 1) on the mating side. One screw [3] is shown from below at the outer end, one from above in the panel opening.

notes_internal: Title block UPC box reads '11/13' (front end sheet metal); used verbatim as group.
Torque triangle 1 is next to both nut [2] callouts; screws [3] have none.
C/MBR extension brackets and guard asm (both 'SEE UPC 14') attach with uncalled bolts/washers; not this page.
Exact pairing of each screw [3] with each nut [2] not clear in the drawing.
Title block: L-86500, DR JM/C1, CK 4-21-69 C1, C/O A3, no revisions.
